usageNotes: Use this to read the current state of all cluster-wide Ceph OSD flags (e.g. noout, pause, noscrub) before performing maintenance or troubleshooting recovery stalls. The cluster identifier is the Ceph FSID, not a human-friendly name. All authenticated users can call this endpoint — no elevated privilege is required.

examples.summary: List all OSD flags for a known Ceph cluster

tips: The 'noout' flag is commonly set during host reboots or disk replacements to prevent Ceph from rebalancing prematurely — check it is cleared after maintenance.
A 'pause' flag halts all client I/O cluster-wide; seeing it set unexpectedly indicates a blocked maintenance operation.
Use the returned 'description' field for human-readable context on each flag before deciding whether to set or clear it.
The cluster FSID can be retrieved from list_ceph_clusters and is stable for the lifetime of the cluster.
